items.title: The Hot 100 flows through social media, so Billboard is bringing YouTube data back into its charts
items.summary: Billboard and YouTube have kissed and made up. A disagreement between the two companies kept the latter out of the former's chart calculus for about a year, but Billboard is adjusting its weights to give more recognition to ad-supported streams that occur on YouTube. As a result, YouTube data will be incorporated into the Billboard charts (again) in 2027 and beyond. Lyor Cohen, YouTube's Global Head of Music, announced the new policy in a blog post.
